completion_decisions: Use paper equations and constants first and the pinned IEA37 wind rose second.
Use the paper-cited Stanley-Ning near-wake continuity rule where the printed Gaussian equation is undefined.
Use pinned NLopt LD_MMA as a declared same-family open production replacement and retain official Svanberg GPLv3 source only as an audited reference asset.
Set the NLopt dual tolerance to 1e-8 and dual budget to 500 after profiling proved that its default 1e-14/100000 serial dual solve dominated the high-performance evaluator.
Parallelize immutable wake precomputation and objective-gradient target blocks within one run, and distribute the paper-native independent starts across all cores for full campaign utilization.
Execute only the paper target MMA topology method; SQP and GA are non-target comparison baselines.
missing_information: author MMA wrapper and internal asymptote states
numeric q-bar convergence reference omitted by the published PDF
machine-readable optimized densities and raw 101-run results

paper.title: Topology Optimization of Wind Farm Layouts

paper_source_conflicts: The paper specifies 3.37MW while the linked IEA37 YAML specifies 3.35MW; the paper controls.
The paper uses a modified Gaussian model with x0 while the public IEA37 source has a simplified Gaussian model; the paper and its cited lineage control.
The small grid origin is not numerically printed; the centered 100m half-cell offset reproduces the 124-site Figure-3 grid.
The published PDF visibly ends the convergence-reference q-bar setting at the equals sign and reports final q values below qmax.
The official Svanberg MATLAB source is GPLv3; the production Apache-licensed platform uses pinned MIT-licensed NLopt LD_MMA and declares the wrapper/asymptote replacement boundary.

scope.claim_boundary: paper-equation and paper-linked-data academic declared reproduction of the topology method and both native problems; not author MATLAB wrapper, random-state, internal-asymptote, or exact numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: raw-density minimum and maximum turbine fractions plus rho_i+rho_j-1<=0 for every site pair within 260m; unordered pairs remove only mathematically redundant directed duplicates

decision_variables.resolution: one continuous density rho in [0,1] for every potential turbine site; 124 and 709 variables

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: RAMP-interpolated continuous densities during optimization and rho greater than 0.5 as the declared installed-turbine postprocessing rule

initialization.resolution: default uniform densities 0.2 and 0.1805; each random run assigns all sites one common scalar sampled in the paper interval and independently samples q_min and delta_q in [0,1]

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: relaxed/discrete AEP, turbine count, feasibility, physical objective evaluations, q path endpoints, stage timings, worker receipts, densities, science hash, and 404 target runs over RAMP/q=0

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize negative annual energy production using density-weighted turbine power and density-weighted RSS wake losses

paper_native_cases.resolution: radius-1300m 124-site grid with 16-64 turbines and radius-3000m 709-site grid with 64-256 turbines

parameters.resolution: q_min=0, delta_q=0.5 every ten evaluations, q_max=10, 0.1 initial MMA step, 200m grid pitch, D=130m, and the two paper count ranges

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: at most 1000 complete objective-gradient evaluations, density-change tolerance 1e-8, and convergence within a stable q stage; the PDF visibly omits the numeric q-bar after its equals sign

update_order.resolution: ordered MMA trajectory with analytical gradients and ten-evaluation q stages; independent starts are hierarchically parallel and commit into fixed start-index slots

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: paper modified 2016 Bastankhah Gaussian model, 8/9 thrust, TI=0.075, RSS deficits, 3.37MW cubic/rated power curve, and declared near-wake continuity completion

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 16 direction bins with the released frequencies and constant 9.8m/s wind speed
